actions.description: Create a new deal.
actions.name: create-deal

name.description: Name of the deal. Example: "Acme Proposal"

company_id.description: ID of the company to associate with this deal. Example: 138551860

primary_contact_id.description: ID of the primary contact person for this deal. Example: 1309859835

value.description: Monetary value of the deal. Example: 1255.23

deal_pipeline_id.description: ID of the deal pipeline. Example: 339554

deal_stage_id.description: ID of the deal stage. Not auto-assigned if omitted. Example: 2599196

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns this deal. Example: 843757

expected_close_date.description: Expected close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-08-15

closed_time.description: Actual close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-08-10

probability.description: Probability of closing (0-100). Setting 0 or 100 closes the deal.

status.description: ID of the deal status. Example: 1

deal_loss_reason_id.description: ID of the deal loss reason.

deal_loss_reason_notes.description: Notes explaining why the deal was lost.

deal_won_reason_id.description: ID of the deal won reason.

deal_won_reason_notes.description: Notes explaining why the deal was won.

deal_source.description: ID of the lead source for this deal.

tag_ids.description: IDs of tags to attach to this deal.

person_ids.description: IDs of people to associate with this deal.

shared_user_ids.description: IDs of users to share this deal with (collaborators).

address_1.description: First line of the deal address.

address_2.description: Second line of the deal address.

postal_code.description: Postal code of the deal address.

deliver_assignment_email.description: If true and assigning to a different user, send an assignment email.

actions.description: Attach a file to a deal, person, or company by URL.

deal_id.description: Deal ID to associate the document with. Example: 55383278

person_id.description: Person ID to associate the document with. Example: 1309859835

actions.description: Create a new person (contact)
actions.name: create-person

full_name.description: The person's full name. Will split on whitespace to set first_name and last_name fields. Example: "James Smith"

email.description: The person's primary email address. Example: "james.smith@acme.com"

email2.description: The person's secondary email address. Example: "james.smith@acme-inc.com"

home_email.description: The person's non-professional email address. Example: "james.smith@gmail.com"

phone.description: The person's primary phone number. Example: "123-123-1234"

home_phone.description: The person's home phone number. Example: "123-123-1234"

mobile.description: The person's mobile phone number. Example: "123-123-1234"

position.description: The person's professional position. Example: "VP of Operations"

summary.description: Summary or notes on the person. Example: "Friendly, answers my calls."

company_id.description: The ID of the company associated to this person. Example: 1

company_name.description: Associates the company with this name to this person, creating it if none matches. Example: "Acme Inc."

user_id.description: The ID of the user who owns this person record. Example: 1

lead_status_id.description: The ID of the lead status to set for this person. Example: 1

lead_source_id.description: The ID of the lead source to set for this person. Example: 1

image_thumb_url.description: A link to the person's avatar. Example: "https://s3.amazonaws.com/avatar.png"

work_address_1.description: First line of work address. Example: "Suite 101"

work_address_2.description: Second line of work address. Example: "123 Fake St."

home_address_1.description: First line of home address. Example: "Suite 101"

home_address_2.description: Second line of home address. Example: "123 Fake St."

facebook_url.description: URL to person's Facebook profile. Example: "https://www.facebook.com/james.smith"

linked_in_url.description: URL to person's LinkedIn profile. Example: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/james-smith-101"

relationship.description: The relationship of the person to the company. Example: "Owner"

is_key_contact.description: Whether or not this person is a key contact for the company. Example: true

unsubscribed.description: Whether or not the person has unsubscribed to newsletters. Example: false

bounced.description: Whether or not the person has had emails sent to them bounce. Example: false
